app_subtext: Connect your bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and Upay merchant & personal accounts. Real-time SMS reconciliation without developer effort.
trust_bullet_1: Automated SMS parsing for bKash, Nagad, Rocket & Upay
trust_bullet_3: Trusted by 12,000+ Bangladeshi merchants & e-commerce shops
login_subtitle: Manage your payment channels and transactions securely
cooldown_error: Too many failed login attempts. For your security, this account is locked for {seconds}s.
generic_login_error: Email or password is incorrect. Please try again.
register_subtitle: Start automating customer payment confirmations in minutes
terms_agreement: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for mobile financial transaction verification.
verify_subtitle: We sent a 6-digit verification link and token to
verify_instruction: Please click the link in your email to verify ownership. If you cannot find it, check your spam or junk folder.
link_expired_message: This verification link has expired or has already been used. Please request a fresh one.
forgot_subtitle: Enter your registered email address to receive password recovery instructions.
forgot_confirmation_body: If an account exists with this email address, we have dispatched a secure password reset link. Please check your inbox and spam folder.
reset_subtitle: Your new password must be at least 8 characters and secure.
token_expired_body: This password reset token has expired or is invalid. For your security, please request a new link.
two_factor_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit verification code from your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or 2FAS).
use_backup_code: Lost access? Use a backup code instead
rate_limit_warning: Warning: Multiple failed attempts will temporarily lock your account.
suspended_subtitle: Your My SAS account has been temporarily restricted by compliance.
suspended_default_reason: Automated security policy: unusual SMS webhook payload discrepancy detected on connected MFS merchant account.
suspended_email_info: Support desk is available 24/7 at support@mysas.com.bd or +880 9612-000000.
onboarding_title: Welcome! Set up your first business
onboarding_subtitle: Create your merchant profile to start mapping bKash, Nagad, and Rocket payments.
profile_subtitle: Manage your identity, phone number, and interface preferences
unsaved_changes_warning: You have unsaved edits. Are you sure you want to navigate away?
avatar_upload_instructions: JPG, PNG, or WebP. Maximum size 2MB.
avatar_size_error: File size exceeds 2MB limit. Please choose a smaller photo.
avatar_type_error: Only JPG, PNG, and WebP images are supported.
businesses_subtitle: Switch between your e-commerce storefronts or add new retail entities
no_businesses_found: No businesses found matching your query
security_subtitle: Review authentication safeguards, update credentials, and inspect security health
change_password_subtitle: Choose a strong password that you do not use on other merchant platforms
two_factor_card_description: Protect your payout credentials and SMS webhook logs by requiring a one-time TOTP code upon login.
step1_desc: Scan this barcode using Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator.
manual_key_label: Or enter this manual secret key:
step2_desc: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app to confirm setup.
step3_desc: Store these 8 single-use recovery codes in a safe place. If you lose your authenticator device, each code can be used once to access your account.
backup_codes_notice: Do not share these codes with anyone. My SAS staff will never ask for them.
saved_codes_confirmation: I have safely stored these emergency backup codes offline.
disable_2fa_modal_desc: Warning: Disabling 2FA lowers your account defense against unauthorized access. Enter your password and current 6-digit code to proceed.
sessions_subtitle: Review all desktop and mobile devices currently authenticated into your merchant account
revoke_all_others_button: Sign out of all other devices
revoke_dialog_desc: This will terminate sessions on all other phones, tablets, and computers. You will remain logged in on this current browser.
no_other_sessions: No other active sessions. You are only signed in on this current browser.
history_subtitle: Audit trail of all recent sign-in attempts, device platforms, and security events
not_you_warning: Notice unfamiliar logins? Change your password and revoke sessions immediately.
no_history_found: No login events found for the selected filters.
delete_subtitle: Initiate permanent account removal and data purge after grace period
delete_step1_desc: When you request account deletion, your account enters a 14-day grace period. During this period, all active SMS payment verifications will pause, but your data is preserved in case you wish to cancel.
delete_retention_note: By Bangladesh MFS & Central Bank regulations, financial ledger records and completed transaction receipts must be archived for auditing purposes.
delete_step2_desc: To confirm deletion, please type DELETE or your account email ({email}) in the box below:
delete_step3_desc: Re-enter your account password to verify that you are the verified account holder.
pending_deletion_banner_desc: Your account is scheduled for permanent deletion on {date} (Grace period active).
cancel_deletion_confirm: Are you sure you want to cancel the deletion request? Your account will be restored to full active status.
